findings.issue: NOT_PASS still unconditionally parses any existing helper/tests/result/response/view JSON.
findings.effect: A malformed partial artifact may prevent recording the real failure instead of preserving the raw evidence.
findings.recommendation: Use the actual completed terminal classification to adapt missing/invalid reads minimally after terminal; do not introduce a generalized defensive parser framework.

findings.issue: The visualization branch is selected by if view truthiness, then states 3PNG/GIF and embeds all fixed filenames.
findings.effect: A running/not_pass or partial view manifest can produce false completeness claims and nonexistent links; no pixel review is required in that branch for NOT_PASS.
findings.recommendation: Report the actual view status and existing artifacts only; distinguish missing display or unavailable pixel inspection. Never fabricate a completed decrease state or a finished image set.

findings.issue: Test/helper/progress links are unconditional and missing production counts default to0.
findings.effect: Early failures may produce broken links and convert unknown/missing calls into apparently observed zero calls.
findings.recommendation: Only link existing files; show missing/not_available for absent counters. Preserve started/completed values where actually recorded.

findings.recommendation: Say qualification of arbitrary new LF geometries/tasks remains incomplete; existing interfaces and the tested physical task are implemented.
